SELECT 'ANIMAL' AS CAT_TYPE, m.A_MAIN_TYPE AS MAIN_NAME, s.A_SUB_TYPE AS SUB_NAME, s.A_SUB_NO AS SUB_NO /* ← 이 별칭이 반드시 있어야 함! */ FROM PC_ANIMAL_MAIN m INNER JOIN PC_ANIMAL_SUB s ON m.A_MAIN_NO = s.A_MAIN_NO
UNION ALL
SELECT 'PRODUCT' AS CAT_TYPE, m.I_MAIN_TYPE AS MAIN_NAME, s.I_SUB_TYPE AS SUB_NAME, s.I_SUB_NO AS SUB_NO /* ← 여기도 마찬가지! */ FROM PC_ITEM_MAIN m INNER JOIN PC_ITEM_SUB s ON m.I_MAIN_NO = s.I_MAIN_NO
